panel_admission.rule: no comparison crosses panels; enforced by multiobjective_qualification.assert_not_cross_panel

new_axis_introduced.name: surrogate_calls
new_axis_introduced.why: HN-GFN spends its 1000-call oracle budget while training against a learned proxy; COMPOSE pays the evaluator directly. Without this axis an oracle-efficiency comparison reports amortization.

drd2_oracle_shared_provenance.claim: HN-GFN's oracle/scorer/drd2/clf_py36.pkl is the pickle COMPOSE's frozen DRD2 oracle was extracted from
drd2_oracle_shared_provenance.method: shasum -a 256 on the clone, compared with provenance.pickle_sha256 and provenance.pickle_bytes in artifacts/oracles/drd2_svm_v1/drd2_oracle_manifest.json
drd2_oracle_shared_provenance.does_not_license: a claim of bit-identical scores; COMPOSE uses extracted numpy parameters and HN-GFN calls sklearn predict_proba. Score parity is UNVERIFIED.

open_decisions: Panel B objective pair is not frozen. {DRD2,QED} admits HN-GFN and excludes InversionGNN; {GSK3b,JNK3} admits both externals and is not COMPOSE's frozen axis. Recommendation: {GSK3b,JNK3}. Must be frozen before any outcome exists.
Whether COMPOSE has a legitimate global de novo arm and can enter Panel B at all.
recommended_minimum_baseline_set: internal generate-and-rank P3/P4 in Panel A (Lane 4 owns the run)
unresolved_fairness_risks: surrogate-versus-direct oracle asymmetry; mitigated by an axis and a refusal, not eliminated
HN-GFN's linear weighted sum cannot express nonconvex front regions a Chebyshev can reach; a method property, never a COMPOSE win
Panel B's objective pair choice is not neutral between the two externals
local environment is rdkit 2025.09.6, not the production pin 2024.03.5; no canonical key produced locally is claim-bearing
